summary: Enterprise Financial Services Corp filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a $ aggregate principal amount offering of Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036. The notes bear interest at a fixed rate until 2031 and then float at a spread over Three-Month Term SOFR. The issuer may redeem at par on or after 2031, or earlier upon a Tax Event, Tier 2 Capital Event, or required registration under the Investment Company Act. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, and not listed on any exchange. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation. Risk-arb angle: n/a.
